name: Remote Ears (powered by ka9q-ubersdr)
author: on8st
description: Diversity reception from the public ka9q-ubersdr receiver network. QSO Assist puts your own radio in the left ear and whichever remote station copies the frequency best in the right, choosing and re-choosing on its own and delaying the two into step. The map shows where you are being heard while you transmit, with a recording from each receiver. Audio never enters the Zeus DSP chain. Not affiliated with the UberSDR project or with ka9q-radio; the name follows theirs (github.com/ka9q/ka9q-radio).
